facts.fact: Agence Ecofin, citing FIIAPP, says an EU-funded second phase (EUR 1 million, 2015-2017) extended a hospital information system with one medical record per patient to ten more hospitals, reaching 16 hospitals by the end of the programme.
Agence Ecofin says an AFD-backed programme of EUR 27.3 million from 2019 provided for electronic medical records, digital medical archives and telemedicine in public hospitals.
facts.system: AFD-supported hospital electronic medical record programme
